item.title: What I Want From a Retro Machine
item.description: My problem is that I’m hardly picky. So I tried to narrow it down: Mega Drive-class graphics, no line numbers, and hardware I can actually PEEK and POKE. Here’s how the X16, MEGA65, C64U, and Agon stack up, and why I’m probably starting with a 6502 on a breadboard anyway.
